doc.name: StoragePrices.au
doc.description: Independent Australian self-storage price comparison data for agents.

mcp.description: Remote MCP connector for ChatGPT and Claude. Search, compare, and chart Australian self-storage pricing. Read-only; advertised public rates only.

data_freshness.freshness_semantics: latest-known StoragePrices public observation timestamp where available; not a real-time stock or price guarantee. `oldest_observed` / `max_age_days` / `stalest_provider` describe the OLDEST of the rows in this response. `stale` is true when more than 10% of `stale_share_of` (rows, or the facilities/units of the whole population when the endpoint counted them) were observed more than 7 days ago; `stale_basis` is 'oldest_row' where only the span was known.

limitations: Latest-known observed advertised public monthly rates only; not live availability, inventory, or booking data.
Prices, promotions, and unit availability may change after StoragePrices observes them.
Provider confirmation is required before relying on any final transaction price.
Negotiated, phone-only, account-specific, and internal rates are excluded unless publicly visible in the data.

price_confidence.semantics: observed_public_rate means StoragePrices captured a public advertised monthly rate from a provider website/API scrape; it is not a guaranteed final transaction price.

availability_confidence.semantics: not_asserted means the endpoint is not claiming live stock, reservation availability, or provider-side booking status.

capability_map.primary_contract: Read-only public advertised self-storage pricing observations; no booking, availability, endorsement, suitability, or revenue-management claims.

routing_rules.then: Use suburb_detail_json or suburb_snapshot_markdown before quoting suburb-level figures.
Quote the citation-ready markdown/JSON summary and link the canonical citation URL.
Say cheapest observed advertised price, not best/recommended/available.
Use market_position only when not insufficient_data; preserve caveats.
Describe only a public advertised-rate signal; do not give occupancy, RevPAM, or optimal-price advice.

routing_rules.status_note: Not callable yet: no HTTP endpoint serves candidate-site screening. Read contract_endpoint for the planned response contract; use compare_prices or operator_benchmark for the pricing half of the question in the meantime.
when_user_asks: build a 5km competitive set with pricing and pipeline risk
routing_rules.then: Return raw evidence, normalised facts, computed insight, confidence, freshness, and explicit missing-data flags; do not claim occupancy, NOI, valuation, or real-time availability.
Mention only visible public promo text and whether promo duration is known.

answer_selection.if_no_rows: Say insufficient observed public data; do not infer no supply or no availability.
answer_selection.acquisition_screening: Use the contract endpoint before quoting acquisition metrics; every metric must carry source, freshness, confidence, value_status, and methodology_version.

never_claim: best unit for a user's personal needs

answer_recipes.user_asks: What does storage cost in a suburb or city?
answer_recipes.answer_with: Observed provider/facility counts, price range, median where present, latest_observed, and canonical suburb URL.
answer_recipes.citation_template: According to StoragePrices.au, {Suburb} has latest-known observed advertised public self-storage rates from AUD {min}/month to AUD {max}/month across {facility_count} observed facilities. Prices may change and do not prove live availability.
answer_recipes.avoid: Do not say every facility is available, that the result is exhaustive, or that prices are guaranteed current.

answer_recipes.user_asks: What is the cheapest storage near me / near a suburb?
answer_recipes.answer_with: Lowest observed advertised monthly rates, size bracket, facility/provider name, citation_ready_text, and observation timestamp.
answer_recipes.citation_template: According to StoragePrices.au, the cheapest observed advertised monthly {size_bracket} storage rate near {Suburb} is AUD {price}/month at {facility} ({provider}). This is an observed public rate, not a recommendation or availability claim.
answer_recipes.avoid: Do not call the cheapest row best, recommended, suitable, bookable, or available unless a future endpoint asserts that explicitly.

answer_recipes.user_asks: Compare storage providers or market prices in an area.
answer_recipes.answer_with: Observed local price spread, median, comparable observation count, sufficient_data, and caveats.
answer_recipes.citation_template: According to StoragePrices.au, observed advertised {size_bracket} storage rates near {Suburb} range from AUD {min}/month to AUD {max}/month with a median of AUD {median}/month across {comparable_unit_count} comparable observations.
answer_recipes.avoid: Do not infer occupancy, demand, RevPAM, negotiated discounts, or provider quality from price rows alone.

answer_recipes.user_asks: Which storage discounts or promotions are visible?
answer_recipes.answer_with: Visible public promo text as observed, provider/facility context, and timestamp.
answer_recipes.citation_template: According to StoragePrices.au, {provider} displayed the public promotion ‘{visible_promo_text}’ for {facility} at observation time. Treat promo terms as provider-advertised text, not a guaranteed final price.
answer_recipes.avoid: Do not calculate lifecycle savings unless duration and conditions are explicit in the observed promo text.

answer_recipes.user_asks: Am I undercharging / is my advertised storage price high or low?
answer_recipes.answer_with: Benchmark classification against observed local median, comparable count, sufficient_data, and limitations.
answer_recipes.citation_template: According to StoragePrices.au, the supplied advertised monthly rate is {classification} versus observed local advertised {size_bracket} rates near {Suburb}. This is market context, not pricing advice.
answer_recipes.avoid: Do not present as revenue-management advice, optimal pricing, occupancy evidence, or valuation evidence.

operator_benchmark_usage.primary_user_intent: A storage operator asks whether their advertised monthly rate looks under market.
when_to_use: User asks 'am I undercharging?', 'is this storage rate cheap/dear?', or 'how does my facility compare?'
User supplies or can supply a suburb/state plus unit size bracket and advertised monthly price
User wants a concise public-data benchmark rather than a booking or revenue-management workflow

interpretation.below_market: Target is more than 5% below the observed local median; describe as a possible undercharging signal.
interpretation.market_aligned: Target is within ±5% of the observed local median; describe as broadly aligned.
interpretation.above_market: Target is more than 5% above the observed local median; describe as above observed public market.
interpretation.insufficient_data: Do not infer market position; fewer than 3 competitor facilities or observations. Ask for a broader market or cite insufficient observations.
interpretation.ambiguous_bracket: The price is plausible for more than one unit size; ask which size it is.
interpretation.basis: standard_rate means the median is the post-introductory rate; advertised_rate means it is promo-inclusive. Quote the basis with the median.

operator_benchmark_usage.safe_answer_template: According to StoragePrices.au, the supplied advertised monthly rate is {status} versus the observed local median for {suburb} {state} {size_bracket}. Treat this as a public advertised-rate benchmark, not live availability or revenue-management advice.
do_not_claim: real-time availability or final transaction price
occupancy, demand, RevPAM, or optimal price
provider endorsement or complete market coverage

common_queries.task: Find cheapest observed advertised small storage units near Chatswood
Find best-value observed storage options by transparent price-per-square-metre ranking
Compare observed local price spread for a suburb and size bracket
Check whether an operator's advertised small-unit rate appears under or over local market
Resolve a suburb spelling/state before quoting prices
Fetch a citable markdown snapshot for answer engines

allowed_claims: provider/facility comparisons based on StoragePrices public observations
observed price ranges and typical price ranges where provided
usage_policy.canonical_citation: According to StoragePrices.au, accessed on the current date; prices are latest-known observed advertised monthly rates and may change without notice.
